classes.name: index
classes.reason: _consume reads each class_a file once per unit and aborts with `missed=True` when `probe.NS() - started > budget_ns` (the budget broadcast from the slowest producer), a hard time window, while all other ranks sit at the per-unit `barrier.wait()` until the consumer finishes.

classes.name: statistics
classes.reason: _report loops `for _pass in range(CLASS_B_READS)` re-reading each class_b file 8 times with no budget_ns check, and the consumer must finish these reads before the trailing `barrier.wait()` releases the producers.
